First, convert 10 weeks and 1 day to days:  
10 weeks = 70 days, plus 1 day = 71 days earlier.  

Date given: 1138-10-29 (ISO format).  
Subtract 71 days:  
October has 31 days, so going back 29 days from Oct 29 → Sep 30.  
Remaining days: 71 - 29 = 42 days earlier from Sep 30.  
September has 30 days, so back 30 days → Aug 31.  
Remaining: 42 - 30 = 12 days earlier from Aug 31 → Aug 19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1138-08-19
